title: Illustration Intro
slide_intent: Set the relative prominence of illustration before selecting a style. A playful drawing should leave enough attention for the food itself.
strategic_value: Instacart can use illustration to add humor while food remains the main attraction.
demonstration: One large statement on cream compares illustration to seasoning a dish. A small section label sits above it.
practical_value: Check an illustrated composition by asking whether the drawing adds a useful note or overwhelms the food.

content_islands.spec: Place Illustration Intro beneath the quiet running header.

content_islands.spec: Set the food metaphor in large dark green type across several lines, holding the rest of the cream page open.
